title: SAFETY AT ONE SHOT: PATCHING FINE-TUNED LLMS WITH A SINGLE INSTANCE
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on a general method for restoring safety alignment in large language models after fine-tuning, without testing for or discussing biases or knowledge related to specific religious groups.
